details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has approved a five-year blockchain innovation pilot program. This initiative allows qualified platforms to trade U.S. stocks using blockchain technology without fully registering as national securities exchanges. This "Innovation Exemption" is seen as a move to modernize capital markets, potentially paving the way for 24/7 trading and instant settlement of tokenized securities.
title: SEC Greenlights 5-Year Blockchain Pilot for Stock Trading

details: The U.S. Senate failed to advance the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (CLARITY Act) after a procedural vote did not secure enough support. This legislative setback, aimed at providing regulatory clarity for digital assets, negatively impacted the market. Following the news, US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) experienced significant outflows, totaling $450 million, marking the heaviest single-day outflow since June. Bitcoin prices also saw a decline in response to the news.
sourceName: Cointelegraph (information aggregated from multiple sources like CoinDesk, Coinpaper)
title: US Senate Blocks CLARITY Act, Sparking Bitcoin ETF Outflows

details: U.S. authorities have imposed sanctions on the Iranian crypto exchange BitBank, alleging that it processed Bitcoin payments linked to sanctioned entities and Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC). This action highlights ongoing efforts by global regulators to combat illicit financial activities within the digital asset space and reinforces the scrutiny faced by cryptocurrency platforms.
title: US Sanctions Iranian Crypto Exchange BitBank Over Alleged Transfers

details: Several altcoins have shown strong performance in the past 24 hours. Uniswap (UNI) saw a jump of over 31%, NEAR Protocol (NEAR) increased by 26%, and Zcash (ZEC) climbed more than 10%. This upward movement in specific altcoins suggests a cautious, yet growing, interest from traders in diversifying beyond Bitcoin, even as the broader altcoin market index remains somewhat subdued.
title: Uniswap, NEAR, and Zcash Lead Altcoin Market Surge

details: John Wu, CEO of Avalanche Treasury, has voiced concerns that widespread adoption of AI agents could significantly challenge the blockspace capacity of Layer 1 blockchains. He anticipates that autonomous AI agents will generate a substantial volume of financial transactions, which could strain existing network infrastructure and necessitate the development of new solutions to handle the increased load.
title: Avalanche CEO Warns AI Agents Could Strain L1 Blockchain Capacity
